mentions.name: Liel
mentions.description: This tool compares and integrates LLM memory as a single file. Instead of storing LLM memory in Markdown, it manages memory as a graph structure to record relationships between tasks and decisions and persist when, why, and how they changed.
mentions.problem: Saving LLM memory in Markdown makes it hard to record relationships between tasks and decisions and to persist when, why, and how they changed.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on Liel (https://hy-token.github.io/liel/), a tool that can compare and integrate LLM memory as single file.
